rag.text:
Test: TC-5766 — SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-513 OKR - Linking Boxes To KR
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
Checking ulinking boxes to key-result in OKR module

Steps:
1. Open OKR module in boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-5766 SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
   Expected: OKR module is opened. No OKR connected to this box message is visible
2. Navigate to OKR settings → General and enable "*Displaying connected boxes in the OKR Overview*"
   Expected: Displaying connected boxes in the OKR Overview is enabled
3. Navigate to OKR Overview → Layout → Display settings and enable *Show connected Boxes*
   Expected: Showing connected boxes is enabled
4. Create Objective and Key-result
   Data: * Objective 1
* KR-1
   Expected: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR Overview
5. Open Key-result → click *Edit linked boxes* button → in box name field find boxName, select and click save
   Data: boxName: TC-5766 SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
   Expected: Box is linked to Key-result. Linked box is visible in *Linked issues & boxes* in KR detail
6. Open OKR Overview
   Expected: OKR Overview is Opened. Objective, Key-result and linked box under KR is displayed

* Objective 1
** KR-1
*** boxName: TC-5766 SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
7. Open Key-result and click *Edit linked boxes* button
   Expected: BoxName is selected and visible
8. Unselect boxName and click Save
   Data: boxName: TC-5766 SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
   Expected: Box is not visible in Linked issues & boxes section in Key result
9. Open OKR Overview in boxName and refresh the page
   Data: boxName: TC-5766 SPM - OKR - Unlinking boxes from KR
   Expected: Linked Box is not visible

Only Objective and Key-result is displayed

* Objective 1
** KR-1
